about: Daily log of the CRYPTO STATEMENTS Market Structure labels (struct-v1): one row per UTC day, each pillar's label, direction and figures with their own as-of dates, computed from the files the daily job writes. Appended, never altered. A label change is also a market alert. Context beside the record, never a forecast or a signal. Written by tools/structure.mjs.

rules.Liquidity: Total stablecoin supply across all chains (DefiLlama, market.json): change over 30 days. Contracting at -1.0% or less, expanding at +1.0% or more, otherwise flat.
rules.Leverage: CME bitcoin futures open interest (CFTC Commitments of Traders, Tuesday positions): change over the last four reports. Falling at -10% or less, rising at +10% or more, otherwise steady.
rules.Positioning: Asset managers' net position in CME bitcoin futures against four reports earlier; a change smaller than 2% of open interest is unchanged.
rules.Funding: Perpetual funding on BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT (sig-v1 alert rule). Extreme if the rule fired in the 7 days before signals.json was written, otherwise inside its band.
rules.ETF holdings: Spot bitcoin ETFs summed only on dates every fund in the sum has published (no fund carried forward; a fund with no file for more than 5 days left out; ARK placed at the close its file reflects). Net change over the last five complete changes: inflow if positive, outflow if negative; no label before two complete dates.
rules.Rates: US Treasury 10-year par yield (the Treasury's daily curve): change over the last 21 business days. Easing at -15 bp or less, tightening at +15 bp or more, otherwise steady.
rules.Sentiment: alternative.me Fear & Greed (market.json snapshots), its own bands: under 25 extreme fear, under 45 fear, 45-55 neutral, up to 75 greed, above 75 extreme greed.
